data.name: Nekozuka Hibiki
data.description:
A member of the Engineering Dept. at Millennium School.

Despite being unsociable and unsophisticated in speech, she exhibits a prominent natural talent in engineering and has invented many strange marvelous objects.

Her inventions are practically flawless, and while it wouldn't be too much to call all of them masterpieces, there's always at least one bizarre feature included that leaves their users bewildered.

Personality: Although she is rather introverted, she is quite dedicated with engineering and inventing, similar to the other Engineering Department members. Her passion leads to numerous unusual inventions. She also likes making cosplay outfits as her hobby, one being her cheerleader costume which was made during her first days of making cosplay outfits when she was younger.

Appearance:
Halo: Hibiki's halo is a small yellow barred circle inside another larger two circle which the outer circle is thicker than the inner circle.

Uniform: She has black wavy hair tied in ponytail on her right side with yellow and purple orb connected to a band and engineering googles hanging on her forehead. She has black floppy dog ears, black tail with white tip and gray eyes.

She wears a white and yellow hoodie, a black and gray tank top and short pants underneath, webbed stockings and black boots with Millennium logo on the rim and soleprint.

She also carries two handcarries, a schoolbag with a sling for her tools and an oversized crate for her mortar shells.

Firearm: She uses a silver LRM vz. 99 ANTOS commando mortar with a black baseplate, carry strap, and handle. The muzzle cover appears to be made of cork as opposed to polymer. The Millennium emblem is imprinted on the barrel base and the mortar sights.

She also carries around a black box containing four mortar shells.

Age: 15

Birthday: April 2nd

Height: 154cm

School Year: First Year

Club: Engineering Department

Hobby: Shopping, Cosplaying
